patterns.fa3_use: Require reference/optimized backend parity evidence without making either backend canonical authority.
Allow bounded intermediate render-stage digests or tolerance receipts to localize divergence without promoting upstream claims to current-host evidence.
On optimized-chain timeout or incompatibility, stop and require an explicit governed retry/reselection; no silent fallback.
Keep graph semantics provider-neutral while Vulkan/PTX/WebGPU/CPU-capable implementations remain replaceable execution backends.
Treat frame, motion, depth, normals, masks and temporal history as typed inputs with provenance and evidence references.
